explain.ahr999: Long-term valuation heat. Cycle context, not a short-term entry.
explain.mayer: Price ÷ 200-day average. Rough cold/hot context, not a trigger.
explain.cbbi: Confidence near a cycle peak (0–100). Not a trade signal.
explain.drawdown: How far below the all-time high. Larger means deeper cycle territory.
explain.fng: Short-term crowd mood, 0–100. Extreme fear is often colder; extreme greed warmer. Day-to-day noise.
explain.halving: Where we sit in the ~4-year supply cycle since the last halving. Background timing, not a price target.

chart.title: Ahr999 history
chart.subtitle: One chart for cheap vs expensive
chart.needData: Load Today once to populate chart history.
chart.whatBody: Ahr999 is a long-term Bitcoin valuation thermometer. Lower usually means cheaper cycle territory; higher means warmer or richer valuation. It helps with cycle context, not short-term trade calls.
chart.legendLow: Blue dashed 0.45: bottom guide (below is historically cheap)
chart.legendHigh: Red dashed 1.2: rich guide (above is less attractive for DCA)

zones.bottomBody: Rare historically. If you believe in the long cycle, this is often where patient DCA feels most comfortable.
zones.dcaBody: Where most days sit. Not extreme bargain, not clearly overheated. Good for steady long-term DCA.
zones.watchBody: Valuation is warm. It does not mean an instant top, but chasing hard usually has worse payoff.

chart.tip: Beginner tip: first see which zone you are in, then check Today for trend and confidence. Do not decide from one line alone.

method.title: Philosophy
method.intro: BTC Pulse reads Bitcoin only. It turns a small set of daily indicators into one regime verdict, so you can check the cycle without drowning in charts.
method.dataBody: Primary price feed: Binance BTCUSDT daily closes (via Binance public market-data hosts), UTC day boundary. Sentiment: Alternative.me Fear & Greed. Cycle: Colin Talks Crypto Bitcoin Bull Run Index (CBBI) peak-confidence score. Halving dates are embedded constants. Readings refresh about once every few hours and cache locally for offline use.
method.ahrBody: Ahr999 = (Price / 200-day geometric mean cost) x (Price / exponential growth valuation). Exponential valuation = 10^(5.84 x log10(coin age days) - 17.01), with genesis 2009-01-03 UTC.
method.glossaryLead: Same plain reads as the Today page. Tap a chip there for a one-line tip; this page keeps the full set.
method.weightsBody: Valuation 35% · Trend 35% · Sentiment 20% · Cycle 10%. The homepage shows four lights plus one summary verdict.
method.limitsBody: Ahr999 can look muted near cycle tops as Bitcoin matures. BTC Pulse is a thermometer, not a trading signal. Always do your own research.
method.confidenceNote: We built BTC Pulse for people who trust the long cycle and want a clear daily read on whether thaw is actually forming.
